audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does _prepare_trie correctly identify Account values and route them through encode_node with storage roots?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: _prepare_trie, encode_node, get_storage_root are Python EL (execution layer) Merkle Patricia Trie functions. Target codebase is Prysm, a Go-based CL (consensus layer) client. These functions do not exist in the Prysm codebase.

code_scope.resolution_method: tree-sitter search returned no results for _prepare_trie, encode_node, get_storage_root in Prysm

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does root(S) produce identical Merkle roots as other correct Ethereum MPT implementations for the same state S?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: root(S) for Ethereum state MPT is an EL (execution layer) function. Prysm is a CL (consensus layer) client and does not implement the Ethereum state Merkle Patricia Trie. Prysm's merkle trees (deposit snapshot) serve a different purpose.

code_scope.resolution_method: tree-sitter search for merkle_patricia and state trie root functions returned no EL MPT matches in Prysm

audit_items.title: Does patricialize create LeafNodes with the correct rest_of_key (key[level:]) without off-by-one errors?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: patricialize is a Python EL (execution layer) MPT construction function. Target codebase is Prysm, a Go-based CL (consensus layer) client. The function does not exist in Prysm. Prysm's LeafNode in depositsnapshot/merkle_tree.go is a deposit snapshot merkle tree, not an Ethereum state MPT.

code_scope.resolution_method: tree-sitter search returned no results for patricialize in Prysm
